content.answer: Fix: merge the single-select options by stable id, never rebuild by name — pass every existing option object through unchanged with its original id, and assign fresh ids only to genuinely new names, continuing from max(existing id)+1; rebuilding the list from names alone makes the API mint brand-new ids that silently orphan every existing row reference and clear all data values.
content.reuse_advice: Whenever updating any id-referenced catalog (options, statuses, tags, enum values) via API, always do a merge-by-id diff: carry all existing entries forward with their original ids untouched, append only truly new entries with ids continuing after max(existing id)+1, and never reconstruct the catalog from names alone, since new ids silently break all existing references and wipe row data.
